newsitem.title: UK: PRESS DIGEST - London Evening Standard - FEB 5.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - London Evening Standard - FEB 5.

text.p: Prepared for Reuters by The Broadcast Monitoring Company

Today an American civil jury unanimously found OJ Simpson liable for deaths of his wife Nicole Brown and her friend Ronald Goldman and ordered him to pay 8.5mn stg compensation. The jury is yet to decide on what are expected to be huge punitive damages in a separate hearing.

According to trade sources, in the new battle of the supermarkets the latest ploy to attract customers are 'happy hours' whereby special deals will be offered to customers shopping at certain times of the day. One supermarkets group is considering such an option.
BUYING SPREE PUSHES POUND PAST 200 YEN
On overnight foreign exchanges sterling had a record breaking night. The pound surged against the yen in Asian trading to reach its highest level against the Japanese currency since October 1992.
